# Copilot authoring

When creating or editing an agent, skill, instruction file, `AGENTS.md`, issue form, or PR template,
follow `.github/skills/copilot-authoring/SKILL.md`: awesome-copilot prior art first with a `Source:`
link, official docs under `## References`, no invented frontmatter, least tools, and updated rosters.
